name: Firecrawl
summary: Web scraping, crawling and search for agents: any URL to clean Markdown or schema-shaped JSON, plus a web search with a developer-documentation category, through a REST API, SDKs, a CLI and a hosted MCP server. The vendor documents a keyless tier for search, scrape and parse, capped per IP per day; two measurements from a datacenter were refused.

agentAccess.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-22 18:16Z, no credentials, same as 2026-09-09: REST /v2/scrape 403 (IP looks suspicious); keyless MCP tools/call KEYLESS_ACCESS_NOT_AVAILABLE inside a 200; tools/list names the three documented keyless tools. No measurement from here has reached the documented keyless tier.

payments.notes: 2026-09-22: nothing prices a call to a machine and no surface speaks a payment protocol. The vendor's 402 is an out-of-credits status, not a payment challenge. Humans pay through Stripe ("credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal"); credits are the unit, bought in $5 steps.
